[[File:Mindset62.png|thumb|300px|Satele Shan's mindscape]]
A '''mindscape''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that generated an environment within one's mind, used by powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to haunt and corrupt another's mind while seeing the world before them as mere illusions, such as when the [[Soul/Legends|soul]] of [[Tenebrae]] infected [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] after his own [[Assassination of Valkorion|demise]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|[[Kira Carsen's ship]]}}</ref>

Some time before [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> Tenebrae again [[Tenebrae's curse|infected]] others, locking [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Satele Shan]] within her own mind and feeding off it. In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> a [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|task force]] led by the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s Commander&mdash;formerly known as the Outlander&mdash;were able to enter Shan's mind, release her, and kill Tenebrae for good.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
